summary: A 48px attachment tile with an optional remove control on its corner, plus Thumbnail.Group as a spaced row or an overlapping stack that spreads back out on hover and focus-within. Two accessibility fixes over the sheet: the control is drawn 16x16, under SC 2.5.8's 24px floor, so its target is extended to 24 with a pseudo-element while the paint stays at 16; and it is drawn hover-only, so it is now revealed on focus-visible as well — as opacity rather than mounting, keeping it in the tab order and never losing focus. removeLabel is required by the type whenever onRemove is passed, and max/overflowLabel travel together, both the same discriminated-union shape Avatar uses. The counter tile is Avatar.Group's, borrowed; the sheet draws none.

migration.manual: New item — nothing to migrate. `npx shadcn add @bydiorama/thumbnail`; it pulls in `cn` and expects react and griddy-icons as peers.
